detail.body:
## What does this PR do?

Pin Transformer Engine to `44f31bbeaf99bd30a67b928000d4b980026debd2`, the tip of [`release_v2.20.2-nemo`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/tree/release_v2.20.2-nemo) resolved on 2026-10-09. The effective TE source advances from `6ea2a74a` to `44f31bbe`, picking up the fused grouped MLP deterministic-dprob fix in [NVIDIA/TransformerEngine#3635](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/pull/3635).

## Changelog

- Advance the MCore submodule from `441a987409b8fdd2b90b463f7999bac970109a43` to `4e7f45066b37a88060058ff012eeacb37c90f7d0`, the signed companion [NVIDIA/Megatron-LM#8036](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/8036) revision. Bridge resolves TE through MCore and its dependency-layer check requires their locked TE sources to agree. This advance also includes the 15 MCore main commits between the old gitlink and the companion PR's base; merge the companion PR first.
- Align Bridge's stale standalone TE source declaration with the effective MCore source, and set source metadata to `2.20.2+44f31bbe`.
- Regenerate `uv.lock` using uv 0.7.2 in the existing `nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.08-py3` base. All 345 package names remain unchanged and no unrelated package versions move. The resolver also normalizes existing platform markers; forcing re-resolution on the unchanged base reproduces those same marker changes.

## Validation

- [x] `uv lock` and `uv lock --check` in the supported PyTorch base container.
- [x] `uv run --no-sync pre-commit run --all-files` in a Bridge CI container.
- [x] `.github/scripts/test_docker_dependency_layers.sh`, including exact Bridge/MCore TE source equality.
- [x] Compare the regenerated base and update lock graphs: only the MCore TE requirement and TE package change.
- [x] `git diff --check`.
- [ ] Native TE rebuild/import and H100/GB200 unit/functional CI. Local checks above do not establish GPU runtime correctness; `needs-more-tests` and `full-test-suite` request the expanded CI matrix.

## Before ready for review

- [x] Followed the contributor guidelines; commit signed and signed off.
- [x] Existing dependency validation covers the pin/lock change; no new product tests or documentation are needed.
- [ ] Review the companion MCore PR and final CI results before merging.
